StudentPrefs.title: StudentPrefs
StudentPrefs.description: Per-student non-PII schedule group preferences synchronized across devices by a runtime-derived 256-bit salted key.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest preference update.

/student_prefs/{studentHash}.description: Stores each student's MBU/LAB group and visibility preferences keyed by a 64-hex SHA-256 key never embedded in the client bundle.
